misted_wanderer.name: Misted Wanderer
misted_wanderer.quote: "You cannot find what you cannot see."

herald_jackal.name: Jackal's Howl
herald_jackal.quote: "I herald only one thing — your end."

ink_warden.name: Ink Mark
ink_warden.quote: "Every word written is a chain forged."

weaving_shade.name: Spinning Silk
weaving_shade.quote: "Every thread is a trap I've already set."

ember_smith.name: Forge Wrath
ember_smith.quote: "I forge weapons. You are merely the ore."

sanctuary_weeper.name: Sanctuary's Tear
sanctuary_weeper.quote: "I weep not for you, but for what I must do."

shallow_leviathan.name: Black Tide
shallow_leviathan.quote: "The ocean does not drown — it invites."

faceless_king.name: Ashen Name
faceless_king.quote: "I have no face because I am everyone's fear."

ore_golem.name: Mine's Groan
ore_golem.quote: "The mountain does not fall. It buries."

wounded_moon.name: Lunar Scar
wounded_moon.quote: "Even a wound becomes a crown if you survive it."

choir_forgotten.name: Forgotten Choir
choir_forgotten.quote: "We sing the names of those erased by time."

bottomless_miser.name: Abyssal Greed
bottomless_miser.quote: "There is never enough. Not gold. Not time. Not you."

winter_thorn.name: Winter's Thorn
winter_thorn.quote: "Beauty and ruin wear the same face."

king_ashen_throne.name: Ashen Throne
king_ashen_throne.quote: "Every throne is built on someone's grave. Yours will be no different."

eclipse_warden.name: Eclipse Eye
eclipse_warden.quote: "I do not block the light. I consume it."

nameless_god.name: Nameless God
nameless_god.quote: "I was worshipped before language existed. I will remain after it ends."

final_dusk.name: Final Dusk
final_dusk.quote: "This is not the end of the world. It is the end of yours."

reset_panel.tasks_desc: Deletes all habits, dailies, and to-dos. This cannot be undone.
reset_panel.allies_desc: Locks all unlocked allies. Bond progress will be lost.
reset_panel.skilltree_desc: Resets all skill tree unlocks and refunds your SP.
reset_panel.stats_desc: Resets cognitive stats, rank, gold, and class. This cannot be undone.
reset_panel.nuclear_desc: Permanently deletes ALL data including tasks, logs, stats, and inventory. This cannot be undone.

architect.name: Architect
architect.lore: Builds systems. Thinks in structures. Never improvises. Passive: +20% XP on Sciences category sessions.

ascetic.name: Ascetic
ascetic.lore: Forges the will through suffering. Pain is the teacher. Passive: +20% XP on Spirit category sessions.

linguist.name: Linguist
linguist.lore: Languages are keys. Every key opens a different mind. Passive: +20% XP on Languages category sessions.

warlord.name: Warlord
warlord.lore: The body is the weapon. Discipline is the ammunition. Passive: +20% XP on Body category sessions.

blueprint.name: Blueprint
blueprint.desc: Next 3 tasks logged give +50% Rank XP until midnight.

system_overload.name: System Overload
system_overload.desc: Deal 3× damage to current boss on next task completion.

infinite_loop.name: Infinite Loop
infinite_loop.desc: All sessions in next 2 hours count double for cognitive metrics.

iron_fast.name: Iron Fast
iron_fast.desc: For 24h: each task restores 5 HP. Missed dailies deal 0 HP damage.

meditation.name: Meditation
meditation.desc: For 12h: other skills cost 50% less mana, next 3 focus sessions get +30% Focus Rating.

transcendence.name: Transcendence
transcendence.desc: For 48h: streak cannot break. Rival XP frozen.

babel_mode.name: Babel Mode
babel_mode.desc: Next language session counts across all language subjects.

polyglot_surge.name: Polyglot Surge
polyglot_surge.desc: Push all language subject ranks forward by 2 virtual hours each.

memetic_transfer.name: Memetic Transfer
memetic_transfer.desc: For 24h: Gc and Vm gains also mirror as Gf gains at 50% rate.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.desc: Reduce boss HP by 10% and stun boss for 1h.

tactical_retreat.name: Tactical Retreat
tactical_retreat.desc: Reset boss encounter, gain 25% max mana back.

sharp_focus.name: Sharp Focus
sharp_focus.desc: Sessions with Focus 8+ give +10% bonus Rank XP

flow_state.name: Flow State
flow_state.desc: First session each day gives 1.5× Rank XP

godmind.name: Godmind
godmind.desc: IQ score contributes 0.5× to Rank XP per session

iron_conditioning.name: Iron Conditioning
iron_conditioning.desc: Exercise and Running give +15% Rank XP

pain_threshold.name: Pain Threshold
pain_threshold.desc: Missed daily HP loss reduced by 25%

market_knowledge.name: Market Knowledge
market_knowledge.desc: Selling items gives 60% of buy price

golden_mind.name: Golden Mind
golden_mind.desc: Sessions over 2h give a guaranteed loot drop

aura_of_focus.name: Aura of Focus
aura_of_focus.desc: Allies gain +10% to their stat bonuses

transcendent_will.name: Transcendent Will
transcendent_will.desc: Rival advancement speed reduced by 10% permanently

void_clarity.name: Void Clarity
void_clarity.desc: Once per week: use any active skill at 0 mana cost

polymath.name: Polymath
polymath.desc: Logging 3+ subjects in one day gives +20 bonus XP

cross_training.name: Cross-Training
cross_training.desc: Language sessions give 30% of hours to Humanities ranks

encyclopedia.name: Encyclopedia
encyclopedia.desc: Gc gains increased by 20% from all sources

living_library.name: Living Library
living_library.desc: Reading/Philosophy sessions advance you faster vs rival

omniscience.name: Omniscience
omniscience.desc: All 4 cognitive metrics gain +0.3 flat on each achievement unlock

master.name: Master
master.desc: Reach B rank in any subject

grandmaster.name: Grandmaster
grandmaster.desc: Reach SSS rank in any subject

bloodwork.name: Bloodwork
bloodwork.desc: Science sessions give +20% Rank XP. Other subjects give -5%.
bloodwork.bonus: +20% Rank XP for all STEM tasks and training sessions (Math, Physics, Coding, Chemistry, Biology).
bloodwork.penalty: -5% Rank XP for all non-STEM subjects.
bloodwork.mechanics: Specializes your progression into hard sciences and technical disciplines.

monks_path.name: Monk's Path
monks_path.desc: Prayer/Meditation gives +40% Rank XP. Daily streak log gives +2 XP instead of +1.
monks_path.bonus: +40% Rank XP for Mindfulness and Prayer/Meditation tasks. Daily streak log grants +2 XP instead of +1.
monks_path.penalty: No direct penalty. Requires regular spiritual and mental focus habits.
monks_path.mechanics: Accelerates leveling through consistent mindfulness and mental calm.

iron_routine.name: Iron Routine
iron_routine.desc: Exercise/Running gives +25% Rank XP. Miss a daily -> lose bonus for 24h.
iron_routine.bonus: +25% Rank XP for all Health, Fitness, and Running activities.
iron_routine.penalty: Missing any daily task disables the bonus for the next 24 hours.
iron_routine.mechanics: Enforces unbreakable discipline by tying physical XP bonuses to daily habit consistency.

lexicon.name: Lexicon
lexicon.desc: Language sessions give +20% Rank XP and +0.01 Crystallized Intelligence (Gc) per session.
lexicon.bonus: +20% Rank XP for Language and Vocabulary sessions. +0.01 Gc gained per session.
lexicon.mechanics: Boosts long-term cognitive crystal growth through linguistics.

night_owl.name: Night Owl
night_owl.desc: Sessions after 21:00 give +30% Rank XP. Before 09:00: -10%.
night_owl.bonus: +30% Rank XP for all tasks and sessions completed after 21:00.
night_owl.penalty: -10% Rank XP for morning tasks completed before 09:00.
night_owl.mechanics: Adapts your XP economy for late-night productivity. Incompatible with Early Riser.

early_riser.name: Early Riser
early_riser.desc: Sessions before 09:00 give +30% Rank XP. After 21:00: -10%.
early_riser.bonus: +30% Rank XP for all tasks and sessions finished before 09:00.
early_riser.penalty: -10% Rank XP for late-night tasks completed after 21:00.
early_riser.mechanics: Rewards early morning focus and sleep discipline. Incompatible with Night Owl.

tunnel_vision.name: Tunnel Vision
tunnel_vision.desc: Log ONLY one subject per day: +50% Rank XP. Log 2+: bonus lost.
tunnel_vision.bonus: +50% Rank XP as long as you only complete tasks from a single category throughout the day.
tunnel_vision.penalty: Completing a task from a second category immediately removes the +50% bonus until midnight.
tunnel_vision.mechanics: Hyper-focuses your day on mastering one specific craft.

loan_shark.name: Loan Shark
loan_shark.desc: +40% Gold from tasks. Every midnight: lose 30 Gold debt.
loan_shark.bonus: +40% Gold from all completed habits, dailies, and to-dos.
loan_shark.mechanics: Provides heavy cash flow, but requires active daily tasks to avoid falling into debt.

compound.name: Compound
compound.desc: Every 100 Gold you own generates +1 Gold/day passively.
compound.bonus: Earn passive daily gold interest: +1G for every 100G in your balance (e.g. 1000G = +10G/day).
compound.penalty: No penalty. Requires holding and growing capital.
compound.mechanics: Acts as an in-game high-yield savings account.

miser.name: Miser
miser.desc: 20% discount on shop items, but requires spending restraint.
miser.bonus: -20% cost on all shop gear, consumables, and scrolls.
miser.mechanics: Allows economical buying of gear and supplies.

tithe.name: Tithe
tithe.desc: Each task: pay 3 Gold or lose 5 HP. In exchange: +15% Rank XP from all tasks.
tithe.bonus: +15% Rank XP from every single completed task.
tithe.penalty: Deducts 3 Gold per task. If out of gold, drains 5 HP instead!
tithe.mechanics: Converts financial or physical sacrifice directly into rapid rank progression.

ascetic_loop.name: Ascetic Loop
ascetic_loop.desc: Daily tasks grant +5 flat XP, strengthening long-term streaks.
ascetic_loop.bonus: +5 flat XP on every completed daily task.
ascetic_loop.mechanics: Perfect for players managing many short, regular daily tasks.

double_nothing.name: Double or Nothing
double_nothing.desc: Streak milestone rewards doubled. Miss 2 days in a row: streak resets to 0.
double_nothing.bonus: 2.0x rewards on major streak milestones (3, 7, 14, 30, 50, 100 days).
double_nothing.penalty: Missing 2 consecutive days irreversibly resets your streak to 0.
double_nothing.mechanics: High-stakes gamification for players confident in their consistency.

momentum.name: Momentum
momentum.desc: Each day with 1h+ logged: +2% Rank XP, stacks to +20%. Miss: resets.
momentum.bonus: +2% Rank XP for each day with 1+ hour of tracked activity, stacking up to +20%.
momentum.penalty: Missing a day completely resets the stacked bonus to 0%.
momentum.mechanics: Builds unstoppable compounding habit momentum over weeks.

diversity_lock.name: Diversity Lock
diversity_lock.desc: +20% Rank XP for alternating subjects. Doing 2 tasks of the same category in a row gives 0 XP for the second.
diversity_lock.bonus: +20% Rank XP across all tasks when constantly alternating categories.
diversity_lock.penalty: Completing a second consecutive task in the same category awards 0 XP.
diversity_lock.mechanics: Enforces a well-rounded lifestyle by demanding category rotation.

silence.name: Silence
silence.desc: All skills disabled for 48 hours. Afterwards: all cooldowns reset to 0.
silence.bonus: Instantly resets all skill cooldowns to 0 after the 48-hour vow ends.
silence.penalty: Disables the use of all active class skills for 48 hours.
silence.mechanics: A discipline trial to prepare for devastating boss combat.

ironman.name: Ironman
ironman.desc: HP hits 0 -> lose 25% HP and 10% Gold. Permanently grants +15% Rank XP from all sources.
ironman.bonus: +15% permanent Rank XP boost to all tasks and sessions forever.
ironman.penalty: Cannot be unequipped once activated. Death inflicts heavy resource loss.
ironman.mechanics: True hardcore mode for elite players.

glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon
glass_cannon.desc: +25% Rank XP from all sources. HP damage from missed dailies and negative habits +60%.
glass_cannon.bonus: +25% Rank XP across all completed tasks.
glass_cannon.penalty: +60% incoming damage to HP whenever you miss a daily or trigger a negative habit.
glass_cannon.mechanics: Fast progression at the cost of extreme fragility.

zero_hour.name: Zero Hour
zero_hour.desc: No Gold earned for 7 days. Afterwards: receive 3x of everything you would have earned.
zero_hour.bonus: Triple payout (3.0x all earned gold) delivered after 7 full days.
zero_hour.penalty: You receive 0 Gold from all tasks during the 7-day restriction.
zero_hour.mechanics: A delayed gratification test yielding massive financial returns.

catalyst.name: Catalyst
catalyst.desc: Each OTHER active mutator gives +8% Rank XP. Alone: gives no bonus.
catalyst.bonus: +8% Rank XP per other active mutator (+16% with 3 slots, +24% with 4 slots).
catalyst.penalty: Provides no effect if active by itself.
catalyst.mechanics: The cornerstone modifier for multi-mutator builds.

echo.name: Echo
echo.desc: Switching task categories gives double rewards (2.0x XP and 2.0x Gold) on the next task.
echo.bonus: 2.0x XP and 2.0x Gold on the first task of a new category.
echo.penalty: Repeating the same category does not trigger the double reward.
echo.mechanics: Synergizes extraordinarily well with Diversity Lock.

mirror.name: Mirror
mirror.desc: Completing a task in the same category as previous has a 30% chance to reflect damage to the boss.
mirror.bonus: Reflects damage and deals +15% damage to active boss when repeating a category.
mirror.penalty: Requires serial execution in one single discipline.
mirror.mechanics: Combat and defensive utility for deep single-category study.

resonance.name: Resonance
resonance.desc: If 2+ active mutators share a category: +10% to ALL their positive effects.
resonance.bonus: +10% boost to the magnitude of all mutator effects within matching groups.
resonance.penalty: Requires equipping mutators from identical categories.
resonance.mechanics: Amplifies specialized builds (e.g. 2 Economy mutators active together).

gambler.name: Gambler
gambler.desc: Each task: 20% chance for double rewards (2x), 20% chance for 0 rewards, 60% normal.
gambler.bonus: 20% chance to hit the jackpot (2.0x XP and 2.0x Gold).
gambler.penalty: 20% chance to walk away with 0 rewards.
gambler.mechanics: Adds thrilling RNG variance to everyday task completions.

phantom_load.name: Phantom Load
phantom_load.desc: Yesterday's hours count as +30% today for Rank XP calculation.
phantom_load.bonus: Transfers 30% of yesterday's training time into a direct XP bonus today.
phantom_load.penalty: If no hours were logged yesterday, bonus is 0.
phantom_load.mechanics: Carries forward yesterday's hard work to propel today's gains.

cursed_clock.name: Cursed Clock
cursed_clock.desc: +1 flat Rank XP per logged hour. Lose 2 Gold for every idle hour during the day (8:00-22:00).
cursed_clock.bonus: +1 flat Rank XP for every verified hour of focus.
cursed_clock.penalty: -2 Gold per idle hour during daytime working hours.
cursed_clock.mechanics: Aggressive anti-procrastination clock keeping you active throughout the day.

deja_vu.name: Deja Vu
deja_vu.desc: Working on the same subject 3 days in a row: 3rd day gives +50% Rank XP.
deja_vu.bonus: +50% Rank XP on the 3rd consecutive day of studying the same subject.
deja_vu.penalty: Breaking the subject chain resets the 3-day counter.
deja_vu.mechanics: Rewards 3-day intensive bootcamps on specific topics.

volatile.name: Volatile
volatile.desc: 1st task of day: +100% rewards (2x). 5th+ tasks: +50%. Tasks 2-4: -10%.
volatile.bonus: 2.0x rewards for your first task and 1.5x rewards for hyper-active days (5+ tasks).
volatile.mechanics: Makes starting the morning easy and incentivizes high-volume productivity days.

weight_of_history.name: Weight of History
weight_of_history.desc: Every 100 lifetime logged hours grants a permanent +1% Rank XP.
weight_of_history.bonus: +1% permanent Rank XP per 100 total hours logged (500h = +5%, 1000h = +10%).
weight_of_history.penalty: No penalty. Scales with veteran account age.
weight_of_history.mechanics: Long-term passive progression booster for dedicated users.

mirror_match.name: Mirror Match
mirror_match.desc: 30% chance on completion to autocomplete another task in the same category for 50% reward.
mirror_match.bonus: 30% chance to trigger an instant autocomplete cascade for neighboring category tasks.
mirror_match.mechanics: Creates satisfying combo chains when completing related tasks.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.desc: At daily reset, converts all unspent Mana into Gold (1 Mana = 2 Gold).
alchemist.bonus: Converts remaining Mana into Gold at a 1 MP = 2 Gold rate at midnight.

time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
time_dilation.desc: Sessions require a minimum of 2.0 hours to submit, but grant 3.0x XP and Gold.
time_dilation.bonus: 3.0x XP and 3.0x Gold for long, focused study sessions.
time_dilation.penalty: Sessions under 2 hours (120 minutes) cannot be logged.
time_dilation.mechanics: Designed for uninterrupted Deep Work marathons.

sacrificial_altar.name: Sacrificial Altar
sacrificial_altar.desc: Permanently delete a completed Habit/Daily (min 7d old or streak 5+) for a large reward.
sacrificial_altar.bonus: Massive one-time XP and Gold windfall upon ritual sacrifice of a matured habit.
sacrificial_altar.penalty: The chosen task is permanently erased.
sacrificial_altar.mechanics: Cleanse obsolete routines from your task lists for huge rewards.

twin_souls.name: Twin Souls
twin_souls.desc: Directs 15% of all XP and Gold to the active ally with the lowest XP received.
twin_souls.bonus: Automatically funnels progression to power-level your weakest active companion.
twin_souls.penalty: 15% of your earnings are redirected to the ally.
twin_souls.mechanics: Evenly balances your party's combat and utility power.

inversion.name: Inversion
inversion.desc: Flips focus quality: low focus yields high rewards (1.3x), high focus yields low rewards.
inversion.bonus: Max rewards when logging low focus rating.
inversion.penalty: High focus ratings yield diminished reward multipliers.
inversion.mechanics: Useful when doing background chores, podcasts, or mechanical tasks.

gamblers_ledger.name: Gambler's Ledger
gamblers_ledger.desc: Gold from tasks is banked in a ledger and paid out at weekly reset with a +50% bonus.
gamblers_ledger.bonus: +50% bonus on all accumulated gold paid out at the end of the week.
gamblers_ledger.penalty: Gold remains locked and unavailable to spend during the week.
gamblers_ledger.mechanics: A disciplined high-yield vault for patient savers.

parasite.name: Parasite
parasite.desc: Doubles the effect of all active XP and Gold mutators (both bonuses and penalties).
parasite.bonus: Doubles (2.0x) all positive XP and Gold bonuses from active mutators.
parasite.penalty: Also doubles all associated penalties, debts, and HP risks!
parasite.mechanics: High-risk ultimate amplifier for extreme min-max builds.

null_zone.name: Null Zone
null_zone.desc: Fully disables XP gain, converting 100% of earned XP into Gold at 1 XP = 0.5 Gold.
null_zone.bonus: Massive gold rush from all tasks, dailies, and training sessions.
null_zone.penalty: You earn 0 XP while this mutator is active.
null_zone.mechanics: Dedicated farming mode for purchasing high-end gear and consumables.

chronomancer.name: Chronomancer
chronomancer.desc: Banks a missed day (once every 14 days) to preserve your streak.
chronomancer.bonus: Automatic streak-protection insurance once every two weeks.
chronomancer.mechanics: A safety net against unexpected life emergencies.

guest.mode_banner: Guest Mode — Your progress is saved only on this device.
guest.upgrade_desc: Secure your progress permanently. Full accounts can access premium features, cross-device sync, and community leaderboards.

notifications_panel.reminder_desc: Receive a daily reminder to complete your tasks
notifications_panel.channel_desc: Choose how you want to receive notifications

mutators_ui.ironman_desc: If HP hits 0 — forced prestige triggers. This cannot be undone. In return: +15% Rank XP forever.
mutators_ui.no_discovered_desc: Open Mutator Chests above to decrypt and unlock ancient game modifiers!

focus_stim.name: Focus Stim
focus_stim.desc: Grants +30% Focus multiplier for your next Focus Session.

boss_damage_plus.name: Boss Damage+
boss_damage_plus.desc: Deals +50% damage to the boss in your next Focus Session.

xp_booster.name: XP Booster
xp_booster.desc: Grants +50% XP from all sources for 24 hours.

streak_shield.name: Streak Shield
streak_shield.desc: Automatically protects your character's daily login streak from breaking once if you miss a day.

elixir.name: Elixir of Life
elixir.desc: Restores HP to 100% and grants 10 minutes of complete damage immunity.

focus_scroll.name: Scroll of Focus
focus_scroll.desc: Reduces skill cooldowns by 50% & gives +25% XP.

mechanics.small_heal: Instantly heals your character for 20 HP up to your maximum health pool. Essential for recovering from missed habits or failed tasks.
mechanics.medium_heal: Instantly heals your character for 50 HP. A reliable mid-tier healing flask to keep you in the fight during intense study/work weeks.
mechanics.health_potion: Standard revitalizing potion restoring 50 HP upon consumption.
mechanics.large_heal: A potent high-grade brew that restores 100 HP in one gulp. Ideal for surviving high-penalty legendary quest failures.
mechanics.elixir: The ultimate restorative draught. Instantly refills your Health to maximum and shields you from all incoming damage penalties for 10 minutes.
mechanics.focus_stim: Enhances cognitive focus. Your next Pomodoro session calculates 30% bonus productivity points and extra focus experience.
mechanics.boss_damage_plus: Imbues your strikes with explosive energy. During your next focus session, all damage dealt to the active Raid Boss is multiplied by 1.5x.
mechanics.xp_booster: Multiplies all XP earned from habits, dailies, to-dos, and Pomodoros by 1.5x for a full 24 hours. Stacks with character rank perks.
mechanics.daily_xp_surge: Unleashes a surge of cognitive momentum. For 2 hours, all XP gained from all tasks and sessions is doubled (2x). Great for sprint sessions!
mechanics.streak_shield: A protective safety talisman. If you miss a login day, this shield automatically breaks instead of resetting your character login streak (does not protect individual habit streaks).
mechanics.daily_gold_rush: Directly converts ancient bullion into 200 Gold in your character wallet. Useful for quickly purchasing gear or unlocking new companion slots.
mechanics.focus_scroll: An arcane scroll that accelerates character skill recharges by 2x while simultaneously providing a 25% experience bonus for 2 hours.

kira.name: KIRA
kira.title: The Analyst
kira.lore: She sees patterns where others see noise.
levels: Science sessions give +5% Rank XP
Science bonus → +10%
+0.002 bonus Gf per Science session
Critical hits from Science tasks always trigger
Science subject rank thresholds -10%

neko.name: NEKO
neko.title: The Dreamer
neko.lore: She turns every moment into something beautiful.
levels: Daily task completions give +5% extra Gold
Streak bonus XP +8%
Mana restored +3 when completing a daily
Habit streaks never break on first miss
All Gold gains +15% permanently

void.name: VOID
void.title: The Abyss Walker
void.lore: From darkness comes the sharpest clarity.
levels: Boss damage +10% globally
Critical hit damage ×1.2
Defeating a boss restores +15 MP
Boss HP bars reduced by 5%
All boss damage ×1.5 permanently

luna.name: LUNA
luna.title: The Cat Spirit
luna.lore: She purrs in binary, dreams in starlight.
levels: Exercise sessions give +8% Rank XP
Missed daily HP loss -10%
HP regenerates +1 per completed daily
Auto-heal 5 HP after defeating a boss
Max HP increased by +20 permanently

sakura.name: SAKURA
sakura.title: The Pink Phantom

dashboard.title: Cognitive Metrics
dashboard.body:
Intelligence research has long treated 'IQ' as a single number, but the modern view (Cattell-Horn-Carroll theory, the current mainstream model) breaks it into distinct abilities that grow somewhat independently. This app tracks four of them:
• Gf (Fluid Intelligence) — reasoning through new problems you haven't seen before.
• Gc (Crystallized Intelligence) — accumulated knowledge you can recall and apply.
• Ps (Processing Speed) — how fast you execute routine mental work.
• Vm (Verbal Memory) — holding and retrieving language-based information.
Each one responds to different activities (Math trains Gf, Reading trains Gc), and each has a ceiling with diminishing returns as you approach it — real skill growth slows the better you get, so consistency beats intensity.

training.title: Training
training.body: Log a session for any subject to earn XP, Gold, and gains in the specific Cognitive Metrics that activity targets — the coefficients aren't arbitrary, they reflect which mental skill each subject actually exercises. The suggestion banner points you toward whatever's currently weak or low-effort, which matters most on days you're tempted to skip training entirely — a short session in a low-energy-friendly subject still moves the needle.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.body:
• Habits — repeatable, no deadline. Just + or − whenever you do (or don't do) the thing.
• Dailies — scheduled and consequential: miss one and it costs real HP, which is what keeps them from feeling optional.
• To-Dos — one-time. Complete it, get rewarded, it's gone.
All three route XP and Gold into your character, and where relevant, into your Cognitive Metrics.

character.title: Character
character.body: Your class defines your identity and comes with 3 Active Skills — deliberate, Mana-costed tools you trigger for a burst effect at the right moment, not passive background bonuses. Gear you equip adds flat stat bonuses (PWR, DEF, FOC, MEM, SPD, LCK), each tied to a concrete gameplay effect shown right under its name. The stats table breaks down exactly where every point comes from — Class + Equipment + Base — so nothing about your character is hidden math.

skill_tree.title: Skill Tree
skill_tree.body: A grid of permanent, passive bonuses across 5 branches — Mind, Body, Wealth, Spirit, Knowledge — unlocked with Skill Points rather than Gold alone. You earn SP mainly by defeating Bosses, which is the real link in this system: your daily task completions chip away at a Boss's HP, and beating it converts that effort into lasting character growth instead of a one-time reward.

allies.title: Allies
allies.body: Companions you recruit with Gold, each passively boosting a specific kind of activity rather than a broad stat — one might strengthen Science sessions, another might boost Gold from Dailies. Leveling an Ally up unlocks stronger, more specific versions of their bonus, so your roster ends up shaped around whatever you actually train most.

mutators.title: Mutators
mutators.body: Optional modifiers that reshape how you play. Each one gives a real bonus AND takes something back — nothing here is free, by design. You can have up to 3 active at once, so every choice is a genuine tradeoff: concentrate everything into one subject with a strong bonus/penalty pair, or spread smaller bonuses across the board for less risk. Some Mutators are marked as Synergy pairs — equip both together and their combined effect is stronger than either alone.

shop.title: Shop
shop.body: Spend Gold on Gear (permanent stat bonuses), Consumables (one-time effects), and Scrolls (special limited-time boosts). Boss-drop unique items never appear here — those only come from actually defeating the specific boss they're tied to, so a full Inventory says something real about what you've beaten, not just what you could afford.

rival.title: Rival
rival.body: Johan is an AI-driven rival tracking a parallel version of your stats and commenting on your activity as you go. The weekly comparison table shows precisely where you're ahead or behind on hours, focus, subjects, and Rank XP — a source of light competitive pressure that works even if you're training completely alone.

party.title: Party
party.body: Team up with real friends using a shared invite code. Everyone in your Party can see each other's rank, level, streak, class, and HP — no shared boss, no chat, just visibility. The idea is simple: progress you can't show anyone is easier to quietly abandon than progress your friends can actually see.
